# A Visa Experts

> A Visa Experts is India's trusted No.1 Visa Immigration Company, helping individuals and families with visitor, tourist, transit and permanent residency (PR) visas for the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe and New Zealand. We provide profile assessment, documentation guidance, application support, and interview preparation.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://avisaexperts.com/): No.1 Visa Immigration Company in India — visitor visa guidance for USA, UK, Canada, Australia & Europe.
- [About Us](https://avisaexperts.com/about): About A Visa Experts, led by founder Kaveesh Kapoor, and our team of 40+ legal visa experts.
- [Services](https://avisaexperts.com/services): Tourist visa and transit visa services, requirements and documentation.
- [USA Visitor Visa](https://avisaexperts.com/usa-visa): Complete guide to the USA Visitor Visa & Tourist Visa (B-1/B-2) from India, including requirements, documents, DS-160, fees, processing time and interview preparation.
- [USA B1/B2 Visa](https://avisaexperts.com/usa-visa/usa-b1b2-visa): What the USA B1/B2 Visa is, the difference between B-1 and B-2, allowed activities, validity and interview questions.
- [Canada Visitor Visa](https://avisaexperts.com/canada-visa): Canada Visitor Visa (TRV) guidance, including biometrics and GCMS / CAIPS Notes assistance.
- [UK Visitor Visa](https://avisaexperts.com/uk-visa): UK Standard Visitor Visa guidance, business-visit activities, biometrics and processing.
- [Tourist Visa](https://avisaexperts.com/tourist-visa): Tourist visa services and country guidance.
- [Transit Visa](https://avisaexperts.com/transit-visa): Transit visa requirements and guidance for smooth airport layovers.
- [Immigration Laws](https://avisaexperts.com/immigration-laws): A 2026 guide to immigration laws for the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Europe.
- [Immigration Lawyers & Consultants](https://avisaexperts.com/immigration-lawyers): Talk to our immigration lawyers and visa consultants.
- [Blogs](https://avisaexperts.com/blogs): Visa and immigration guides, tips and success stories.
- [Our Advisors](https://avisaexperts.com/consultants): Connect with a visa consultant by chat, call or video.
